name: Althemone
description: A young companion of the Champion who doubted she could defeat a cyclops with one spear.

description_citations.work: Born of the Gods: card flavor text
description_citations.text: Born of the Gods: card flavor text (Born of the Gods, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Champion and companions pass through a forest of stacked stones.
timeline.quote: On the fourth day they passed through a forest of immense stacked stones.

citation.text: Silent Artisan (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Champion faces a cyclops with a single spear, reasoning that it has but one eye, while young Althemone doubts her.
timeline.quote: The Champion raised her weapon. "It has but one eye."

citation.text: Cyclops of One-Eyed Pass (Born of the Gods, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
